messages:
oliver: Quick FYI — ran a route-scope preview against a tenant with quota overrides and saw perms check allow the preview UI but the backend reject on apply. Repro steps below.

sana: Can you paste the exact API call? Is this the console preview or the API preview endpoint?

oliver: Console preview. Call that the UI makes:
POST /api/v1/route-preview
body: { "route": "/generate", "tenant_id": "acme", "override_quota": { "tokens_per_minute": 10000 }, "include_entitlements": true }
Response 200 in UI, but when hitting /routes/apply we get 403 "insufficient scope".

drew: Sounds like preview_eval uses a cached scope-eval path that doesn't include runtime quota-affinity. Is telemetry showing any mismatched eval_id? @infra-bot can you dump the last preview run for tenant acme?

infra-bot: Requested preview run 1738888888: eval_id pfx-23, policy_version 7, feature_flags: [preview_quota_affinity:true].

maria: If policy_version 7 introduced 'quota_affinity' then preview might be using a fallback policy. Did we ship a hotfix that toggles the gate only for UI? We had a similar gating for canary rollouts.

oliver: Yep — looks like UI sets the 'use_fallback_policy' header when doing preview. Backend apply path ignores that header. So the UI incorrectly says 'you can apply' but backend denies.

sana: We need two fixes: (1) stop UI from sending stale header; (2) make apply endpoint surface the reason code for 403 so console shows 'quota-affinity mismatch' not generic 'insufficient scope'.

drew: Also telemetry: previews should log the policy_version and eval_id and be joined with apply events so we can find these faster. Right now apply events only include policy_hash, not eval_id.

oliver: Agree — action list:
- @sana remove 'use_fallback_policy' from preview (PR)
- @drew add eval_id + policy_version to apply telemetry (PR)
- @maria add UI tooltip explaining that quotas are tenant-scoped and may block apply
I'll open PRs and link here.

maria: :thumbsup: and add a unit test for apply path to assert header-less preview == apply decision.

infra-bot: Deploy scheduled to staging at 2024-11-02T03:00Z (ci/route-preview-fix).

sana: I'll have PR up by EOD and tag you all.

oliver: Thanks — logging this as follow-up for the RBAC runbook. Filing a short postmortem if we see customer impact.
